title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Coverage Re-decision Repayment — Amount Clause
content:
**1. Lines read.** For a coverage re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the repaired concern line is the concern line of that repair order that carries the repair order's diagnostic fee. The amounts read are the store's customer-pay lines of that concern line on that repair order.

**2. Standard repayment.** The coverage re-decision repayment is made of three parts:
- the repaired concern line's labor: the hours billed times the store's posted labor rate capped at the coverage level's labor-rate cap, rounded half up to the cent;
- its parts at list price;
- its diagnostic fee.

The deductible chosen at sale is then subtracted. Shop fees on the repair order are not repaid.

**3. The deductible.** The deductible chosen at sale is taken once for the visit. It is not taken in either of these cases:
- the repair order was written at the store that sold the contract, under a coverage level carrying the disappearing deductible;
- another component-repair line the contract paid on that repair order already took it, under a coverage level that takes its deductible once per visit.

**4. Total.** Every amount repaid on the repaired concern line and the repair order is added, and the deductible taken is subtracted. That total is never below 0.00. It is then capped at the part of the coverage level's aggregate claim limit the contract has not paid out (claims paid less reversals), and is rounded half up to the cent.

**Deductible cases (hypothetical, deductible chosen at sale of 250).**

| Store that wrote the repair order | Coverage level's deductible terms | Another paid component-repair line on the repair order took the deductible | Deductible taken |
|---|---|---|---|
| selling store | disappearing deductible, once per visit | — | none |
| other store | once per visit | yes | none |
| other store | once per visit | no | 250 |
| any store | once per component group, no disappearing deductible | yes | 250 |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).**
- **Labor.** 1.8 hours at a posted rate of 139.95, below the cap: 251.91.
- **Other parts.** Parts at list 218.44 and a diagnostic fee of 89.00.
- **Total.** With the deductible of 250 taken, 251.91 plus 218.44 plus 89.00 less 250 is 309.35. That is paid where the unpaid part of the aggregate limit is at least 309.35.
